entities.name: Post-Cold War & Globalization Era
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The period since the fall of the Berlin Wall (1989) and Soviet dissolution (1991), characterized by American unipolarity, economic globalization, digital revolution, and the rise of China and India. This era saw the spread of democracy, free markets, and the internet alongside new challenges: terrorism, climate change, populism, and great-power competition.
